description: Search Pequerecetas for a dish or an ingredient, in Spanish. The site serves its search on one page and offers no second page, so 'result_count' counts the rows served and 'total_available' is null: the site publishes no count of what a search matched. The rows come in the site's own order, which is not by how well they match, so a dish named in the query can sit well down the page and 'limit' cuts in that order. A row carries the slug that get_recipe takes. Some rows are articles gathering recipes rather than recipes, which get_recipe reports as a 'collection'. To narrow by diet, ingredient, technique or the age of the eater, use list_facets and browse_recipes instead: this site's search takes no filters.

limit.description: Rows to return, at most 60. Left out, every row served comes back.

query.description: What to search for, in Spanish: a dish, an ingredient, a technique.

name: search_recipes

total_available.description: Always null: the site publishes no count of what a search matched.
